source.title: Libya's NOC says 'unlawful' pipeline closure from Sharara oilfield to cut output by 350,000 bpd

disruption.summary: Libya's National Oil Corporation said a valve on a pipeline from the Sharara oilfield was closed by an unlawful group, which it said would cut output by around 350,000 barrels per day. The NOC said a separate Hamada pipeline closure has cost about 15,000 bpd, bringing total losses to about 365,000 bpd. The article does not say who closed the valve or how long the shutdown will last.
